takeaways.text: Route on **98%** / blocks on **2%** of dropbacks (95% CI 91–99%, n=79) — 16 pts above the RB average of 82%.
On routes, averages **5.7 yd** downfield by the throw (n=77, snap→release window only).

Because he releases into a route on ~98% of dropbacks and most often from Backfield, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

example_plays.why: closest to his median route depth (4.8 yd) — a normal rep
farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
